title: Modern Engineering for Design of Liquid-Propellant Rocket Engines
authors: Dieter K. Huzel and David H. Huang
publisher: AIAA (Progress in Astronautics and Aeronautics, vol. 147), 1992

chapters.title: Design of Thrust Chambers and Other Combustion Devices
chapters.why: chamber layout and L*, nozzle shape, gas-side and coolant-side heat transfer, regenerative/film/ablative cooling, injector orifice sizing, gas generators, igniters, instability
chapters.notes: read H&P ch. 4 before 4.4; pairs Sutton ch. 8

chapters.title: Engine Systems Design Integration
chapters.why: 10.2 is the engine-system dynamic model: equations, start/shutdown transients, engine-vehicle interaction, low-frequency instability; 10.3-10.4 calibration and influence coefficients
chapters.notes: pairs Sutton ch. 11; the closest thing in the library to a transient engine-simulation spec

chapters.title: Design of Turbopump Propellant Feed Systems
chapters.why: pump and turbine design parameters, inducers and NPSH, centrifugal and axial pumps, turbine types, rotordynamics
chapters.notes: pairs Sutton ch. 10 and H&P ch. 13

chapters.title: Introduction to Sample Calculations
chapters.why: four sample stage engines (A-1 to A-4) with cycles and start/cutoff sequences; the book's worked calculations build on them
chapters.notes: use as reference cases, not as a module

chapters.title: Design of Rocket-Engine Control and Condition-Monitoring Systems
chapters.why: thrust and mixture-ratio control, control laws, valves and regulators, instrumentation, failure detection, post-flight data analysis

chapters.title: Design of Gas-Pressurized Propellant Feed Systems
chapters.why: pressurant mass calculations, stored-gas, evaporation and chemical-reaction pressurization

chapters.title: Introduction to Liquid-Propellant Rocket Engines
chapters.why: thrust, chamber and nozzle flow, Is, c*, Cf, correction factors, propellant property tables

chapters.title: Engine Requirements and Preliminary Design Analyses
chapters.why: design parameters, mission requirements, preliminary design optimization

chapters.title: Design of Propellant Tanks
chapters.why: tank structure, cryogenic insulation, zero-g expulsion

chapters.title: Design of Interconnecting Components and Mounts
chapters.why: ducts and pressure drop, pump-inlet line vibration, bellows, gimbal mounts
chapters.notes: 9.1 only if modelling line dynamics or pogo
